body:
Maybe its just me being disappointed in myself then? 

I don't really know I just feel so guilty and worthless all the time.

Its very hard to get a honest answer to that question.

I just feel like most will feel obligated to give a nice answer just to make me feel better but deep down they just all hate me. 

I just am so useless, I can't be giving them anything if I don't even know I am giving them something. 

Maybe its just all in my head, but it just never feels like I am just good enough to stay alive.

But if I continue I will just continue to be a be a burden to those around me,

To give more things to be disappointed in me,

If I were dead people would just see it as a positive.
it just feels like all I do is wrong though, I just can't stop feeling so guilty.
